method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 9 of 13 breaks heard

lines.latin: Ave Regína cælórum, Ave Dómina Angelórum:
lines.english: Hail, O Queen of heaven, hail, O Lady of the Angels;
hail, thou root, hail, thou gate,

lines.latin: Ex qua mundo lux est orta:
lines.english: from whom unto the world a light hath arisen.

lines.latin: Gaude Virgo gloriósa, Super omnes speciósa:
lines.english: Rejoice, O glorious Virgin, lovely beyond all others;
and pray for us to Christ.

lines.latin: Dignáre me laudáre te Virgo sacráta.
lines.english: Vouchsafe that I may praise thee, O sacred Virgin.

lines.latin: Da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
lines.english: Give me strength against thine enemies.

lines.latin: Concéde, miséricors Deus, fragilitáti nostræ præsídium:
lines.english: Grant, O merciful God, to our weak natures Thy protection,

lines.latin: ut qui sanctæ Dei Genitrícis memóriam ágimus,
lines.english: that we who commemorate the holy Mother of God

lines.latin: intercessiónis ejus auxílio a nostris iniquitátibus resurgámus.
lines.english: may, by the help of her intercession, rise again from our iniquities.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
